definitions.explanation: Matters related to hiring, firing, transfers, and management of employees.

definitions.gloss: human affairs; what lies within human power
definitions.explanation: An older sense, met almost only in the proverb {人事|じんじ}を{尽|つ}くして{天命|てんめい}を{待|ま}つ: what a person can do, as against what is left to fate.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}⟦{部|ぶ}→部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{人事|じんじ}⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There will be major personnel changes next month.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くして→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧⟦{天命|てんめい}→天命：07887_tenmei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Do your best and leave the rest to fate. (proverb)

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work in the personnel department.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{人事|じんじ}⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was transferred due to a personnel change.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted with the HR person.

notes:
{人事|じんじ} is personnel management — hiring, transfers, evaluations, and the department that handles them. In business Japanese it is one of the standard department names, alongside ⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧ and ⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人事|じんじ}⟦{部|ぶ}→部：00440_bu⟧ (HR department, personnel department)
- {人事|じんじ}⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧ (personnel transfer, job reassignment)
- {人事|じんじ}⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧ (personnel evaluation)
- {人事|じんじ}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当する：02567_tantou⟧ (the person in charge of HR)

WATCH THE READING:
- Sense 2 is confined in practice to the proverb {人事|じんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くして→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧⟦{天命|てんめい}→天命：07887_tenmei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (do everything you can, then leave the rest to fate). Outside it, {人事|じんじ} means HR.
- The similar-looking ⟦{他人事|ひとごと}→他人事：09570_hitogoto⟧, 'someone else's problem', is a separate word with its own reading.
